activity_b.text: Good morning, please have a seat.
I’m Mr. Pathmanathan, the ICT training supervisor.
How are you feeling today?
Good morning, sir. I’m doing well, thank you.
I’m a bit nervous, but I’m ready to try my best.
That’s completely fine.
This is a friendly interview.
So, Kiran, I see that you completed school last year.
Could you tell me a little about your background?
Yes, sir. I completed my A/Ls in August.
During my final year, I worked part-time at a small ICT support centre in Vavuniya.
I don’t have a lot of experience yet, but I can manage basic technical tasks confidently.
Good.
What kind of work did you support in the ICT centre?
I assisted the technician with troubleshooting minor network issues, installing basic software, and checking system updates.
I also helped set up new workstations and sometimes organised cables to keep the desks tidy.
When the centre became busy, I answered customer calls and prepared simple diagnostics reports.
I wasn’t responsible for major repairs, but I always supported the team whenever they needed help.
Excellent.
What skills do you think you can bring to our training programme?
I can install operating systems, sir.
I know how to configure simple routers, and I recently started learning how to replace faulty RAM modules.
I also learnt how to stay calm when customer issues become urgent.
I might need some guidance with server maintenance and advanced network configuration, but I’m going to improve quickly.
That’s a positive attitude.
How comfortable are you with hardware checks and basic network tasks?
I’m not fully confident yet, but I can already handle simple hardware inspections and basic LAN setup.
I might take more time with complex repairs and multi-layer network systems.
That’s understandable.
What are your plans for the next few years?
I’m going to complete this training programme and then apply for an apprenticeship.
I might also follow short cybersecurity courses to strengthen my technical skills.
Very good.
Thank you, Kiran. We’ll contact you soon.
Thank you very much, sir. I appreciate the opportunity.
